arStrings.szText: {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} shoots out smaller Lesser Demon Skulls that seek enemies and deal {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_MINI}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} is now also a {c_important}Summon{/c} Skill and orbits you for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds. The skull deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_ORBIT}{/c} damage and extends {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} when it hits enemies. Channeling increases the orbit speed by {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} and refreshes the duration.

{c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss Recast Summon{/c} Skill, seeking your target location for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds and Knocking Down enemies the first time it hits them. Enemies near the skull take {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_PROXY}{/c} damage and become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}. Channeling redirects the skull and refreshes the duration.
{c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} gains up to {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and speed based on your Movement Speed Bonus.
Hitting any enemy with {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} reduces its cost by {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage based on how many different enemies it has hit, up to {c_number}[{SF_26}*{SF_27}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Blazing Scream's{/c} primary skulls instantly detonate {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} as they travel, increasing that skull's damage by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%|]{/c} per {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_31}*{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c}.
